prompts:
Create an original polished educational four-panel comic for 方片 AI学院. The two attached images are CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY: preserve this exact cute golden-yellow tiger IP, rounded head/body, cream muzzle and belly, large expressive brown eyes, brown forehead/cheek stripes, small round ears and striped tail. Teacher version may wear its round brown glasses. Consistent light 3D clay/Pixar-style rendering matching these assets, not a human character, not a different tiger design. Warm paper-white backgrounds, charcoal thin rounded panel frames, Fangpian yellow accents, small restrained technology blue. One wide landscape image, exactly FOUR equal vertical comic panels in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, read left to right; uniform gutters and aligned boundaries; fill canvas without enormous outer whitespace. Each panel includes one large clean white speech bubble in its upper quarter and tiger/action in lower three quarters. Clear simplified classroom/tabletop props; coherent tiger proportions in every panel. Speech bubbles contain only the exact short simplified Chinese sentence specified, legible dark handwritten print. No title, no watermark, no author, no URLs, no brand advertising. This image will be split into four equal panels for a responsive website, so keep each scene and its speech wholly inside its own quarter.
TOPIC: 让 AI 按我的情况讲清楚. Panel 1: tiger at desk holding a notebook with a simple percent-symbol icon, pointing to its starting knowledge, curious eager expression. Bubble exact:「我懂百分数，从这里讲！」 Panel 2: tiger discusses two generic shopping items and sale tags with a tiny neutral white AI teaching robot, a concrete shopping-discount example; no invented company or real shop logo. Bubble:「用购物折扣举个例子。」 Panel 3: AI robot offers three question cards, tiger picks up pencil and thinks independently; do not show answers. Bubble:「先出题，别急着给答案。」 Panel 4: teacher tiger points with pointer at two different discount price tags and circles the calculation target on a shopping receipt, student tiger notices potential confusion. Bubble:「提醒我最容易错在哪里。」

TOPIC: AI 会生成听起来可信但未必正确的内容，需要核验. Panel 1: tiger listens to a confident neutral white AI robot presenting a shiny document, tiger initially impressed; a subtle tiny question-mark symbol behind the document signals uncertainty. Bubble:「答案听着真像！」 Panel 2: tiger leans forward skeptically, asks for evidence, holding a magnifying glass toward an empty citation card; AI robot pauses thoughtfully. Bubble:「等等，出处在哪里？」 Panel 3: tiger checks a real printed reference book and a second independent document side by side on desk, carefully compares source evidence, no fabricated factual data. Bubble:「查原文，再交叉核验。」 Panel 4: tiger confidently annotates an uncertain claim with a small question mark in notebook and keeps the AI draft separate from a checked note; positive calm conclusion. Bubble:「没核实的，先别当事实。」
